testsJudgement: The implementer's browser tests (pictures.e2e.ts, Desktop Chrome and the iPhone 13 project) cover the acceptance list one for one, and the unit tests (picture-view.test.ts) cover the branch order, the caption rule, the project owner, the error-to-link swap, stopEvent and the schema fallback. No defect found, so no red test was written.
notes: Not exercised: WebKit and Firefox (no Playwright browsers in this pod; the suite's picture cases run on Chromium only, per e2e/playwright.config.ts).

Pre-existing and unchanged here: a paragraph ending in a picture is ~115 px tall whatever the picture (LEGION-701), visible in the screenshots as the gaps between fallback links; a grammar-refused dispatch:// source shows Chrome's broken-image glyph with its alt, as the read-only engine does.

Product observation for the architect, not a defect of this change: `dispatch artifact` prints the version-less reference (dispatch://KEY/artifact/<slug>), so an agent that copies it into a picture line gets the approved 'pins no version → link' rendering, not the picture; the spec chose that rendering (as the read-only engine's).
